records.reason: rewrite-groovy has no node for unary minus, unary plus or `~` and keeps their text in a whitespace Space, which AutoFormat discards. records.upstreamStatus: Cause confirmed by a CI probe (see #1609); no upstream report filed, and none is to be filed without the owner's approval.

Tests ran in CI only; no raw-upstream probe was run.
